## Mouse
### Download datasets
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Benchmarking models ------
#Mouse-------
#Download datasets

#GSE120661 ----

#Metadata 
filename = "GSE120661"
GSE120661 <- getGEO("GSE120661", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
eset <- GSE120661[[1]]

GSE120661_metadata = eset %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    subject_id = "title",
    sex = "gender:ch1", 
    treatment = "treatment:ch1", 
    tissue = "tissue:ch1",
    timepoint = "timepoint:ch1",
    animal_replicate = "animal replicate:ch1",
    strain = "strain/background:ch1") %>% 
  mutate(treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "saline"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, "0"),
         condition = paste(treatment, timepoint, tissue, sep = "_"))

#Save
write_csv(GSE120661_metadata, file = here("tables", "GSE120661_metadata.csv"))

#Counts matrix from Expression set
eset <- exprs(eset)

eset %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_exprs.rds"))

#Import
GSE120661_eset = readRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_exprs.rds"))
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 = GSE120661_eset %>% 
  as.data.frame()

#Save
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2.rds"))

```

#### Get metadata
```{r}
#Import
GSE120661_metadata = read_csv(here("tables", "GSE120661_metadata.csv")) 

#Clean
GSE120661_metadata = GSE120661_metadata %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.integer(timepoint) %>% 
           as.character() %>% 
           as.factor() %>% 
           fct_relevel(., "0"),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "saline"),
         condition = paste(treatment, timepoint, tissue, sep = "_"))

#Save
GSE120661_metadata %>% saveRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_metadata.rds"))
```

Import
```{r}
#Import
GSE120661_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_metadata.rds"))
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2.rds"))

#Check length
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% rownames() %>% length()

mouse_fluad_metadata = GSE120661_metadata %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad",
         tissue == "PBMC") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = (timepoint / 24) %>% round(1),
         participant_id = paste0("TriFLU-MF59_BL", animal_replicate)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7))

#Save
mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_metadata.rds"))

#Select only PBMC samples counts
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 = GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample)) %>% 
  as.matrix()
```

### Annotate genes
```{r}
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% rownames()

#Get other annotations
listAttributes(ensembl_mart)

#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k", #Agilent microarray data (design ID 028005, retrieved from GEO)
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k",
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_fluad_log2summary = GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% #20,845 probes
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_fluad_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

mouse_fluad_log2summary = mouse_fluad_log2summary %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes = GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol, 
         c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample))
#14395
mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes 

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  get_dupes(human_symbol)

#Save 
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
```


```{r}
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_metadata.rds")) 


#Create Expression Set
eset_mouse_fluad <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
    select(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample) %>% 
    as.matrix(),
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("geo_sample")))

#Save
eset_mouse_fluad %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "eset_mouse_fluad.rds"))

#Annotate
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  # rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, human_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long.rds"))


#Pivot wider
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide = mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  select(-c(value:day0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id",
              values_from = "log2fc")

beep()
```

#### Simple t-Test
```{r}
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long.rds"))
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()
```


```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
fluad_log2fc_summary = mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  # rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") 

# Paired t-test
mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired")

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```




#### Limma

```{r}
#Create design matrix -------
eset_mouse_fluad = 
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "eset_mouse_fluad.rds"))

design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + 0, eset_mouse_fluad) # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate correlation between doses on the same individual
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse_fluad, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse_fluad$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.02

# Use the correlation into the linear model
#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse_fluad, design, 
             block = eset_mouse_fluad$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus)

#Contrasts
#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(timepoint1  - timepoint0 ,
                             timepoint3  - timepoint0 ,
                             timepoint7  - timepoint0 ,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs ------
## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
    
})

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs_mouse = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "Time1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA)) %>% 
  select(condition, everything())

all_degs_mouse %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarize(n_degs = n())
	
#Save
all_degs_mouse %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "Fluad_GSE120661_degs_mouse.rds"))
```








## Human

### Download dataset
Data was quantile normalized signal intensity using limma 3.38.3, read.maimages source = agilent.median, backgroundCorrect method= normexp, normalizeBetweenArrays method= quantile. Ref: GEO.

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
### Download dataset --------
# Data was quantile normalized signal intensity using limma 3.38.3, read.maimages source = agilent.median, backgroundCorrect method= normexp, normalizeBetweenArrays method= quantile. Ref: GEO

###### GSE124689 ----
#Download dataset
GSE124689 <- getGEO("GSE124689", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
#Get ExpressionSet
eset <- GSE124689[[1]]
#Expression
GSE124689_exprs <- eset %>% exprs()
#Metadata
GSE124689_metadata = eset %>% pData()
#Save
GSE124689_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "GSE124689_exprs.rds"))
```

Import data

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Get metadata annotated by Amnah
```

### Annotate features
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
# Annotate genes
probes_annotation <- read.delim(here("tables", "GPL21272-58809.txt"), skip = 19, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% 
  select(gene_id = ID, entrez_id = ENTREZ_GENE_ID, ensembl_id = ENSEMBL_ID, gene_symbol = GENE_SYMBOL) %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id))

GSE124689_counts <- GSE124689_exprs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>% 
  inner_join(probes_annotation, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  select(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol, c(human_samples_pbmc_fluad$biosample_accession)) %>% 
  mutate(entrez_id = as.character(entrez_id)) 

#Get probes and entrez IDs with the highest median by ensembl_id
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id, gene_id) %>% 
  drop_na(entrez_id) %>% 
  summarize(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Merge
GSE124689_counts_raw = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
               select(gene_id, entrez_id),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "entrez_id"))

#Delete duplicates by sampling
dupes_entrez = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
  get_dupes(entrez_id) %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

#Merge
human_fluadd_not_normalized = GSE124689_counts_raw %>%
  select(-gene_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!gene_id %in% c(dupes_entrez$gene_id)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(entrez_id, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("entrez_id") 

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE124689_expression_raw.rds"))

#Get symbols only
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol, gene_id) %>% 
  filter(gene_symbol != "") %>% 
  drop_na(gene_symbol) %>% 
  summarize(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
               select(gene_id, gene_symbol),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))

dupes_symbols = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
  get_dupes(gene_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(gene_symbol, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")

human_fluadd_symbol_entrez = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(symbol = gene_symbol, entrez_id)

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol.rds"))
```


```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Counts matrix from Expression set
flu_metadata_clean = flu_metadata %>% 
  arrange(uid) %>% 
  separate(participant_id, into = c("del", "participant_id")) %>% 
  select(-del) %>% 
  select(sample_id = uid, participant_id, timepoint = study_time_collected, age = age_imputed, sex = gender, race, vaccine = exposure_material_reported, sample_type = cell_type, array = featureSetName2, type = vaccine_type, adjuvant) %>% 
  mutate(age = as.numeric(age),
         sex = as.factor(sex), 
         race = as.factor(race),
         condition = paste(vaccine, "Day", timepoint)) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% c(GSE124689_counts %>% colnames())) %>%
```

#### Limma
```{r}
# DGE -------

#Create ExpressionSet
eset_human <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human,
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData))

#Save
eset_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "fluad_eset_human.rds"))

##### Run analysis in the cluster -------
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "fluad_eset_human.rds"))
#Create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + sex + age + race + 0, eset_human) 
#Avoid blank spaces
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

#Get intra-individual correlation
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_human, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_human$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.11

# Fit Limma model
fluad_human_limma_fit <- lmFit(eset_human, 
                             design, 
                             block = eset_human$participant_id, 
                             correlation = corfit$consensus)

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFLUADD.Day.1 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             conditionFLUADD.Day.3 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             conditionFLUADD.Day.7 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fluad_human_limma_fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)


fit2 %>% saveRDS(here("tables","fluad_human_limma_fit.rds"))


# Import results from cluster -------
fit2 = readRDS(here("tables","fluad_human_limma_fit.rds"))

#Get DEGs ------
## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
fluad_human_degs = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace_all(comparison, "\\.", " "),
        comparison = str_replace_all(comparison, "condition", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  select(condition = comparisonA, everything()) %>% 
  select(-comparisonRef) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(condition, symbol, mean = log_fc, lower = ci_l, upper = ci_r, ave_expr,
         everything()) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               select(condition, timepoint, vaccine, sample_type) %>% 
               distinct(), by = "condition") %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") 

#Save
fluad_human_degs %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "fluad_human_limma_fit_degs.rds"))

#Print results

fluad_human_degs %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarize(n_degs = n())
```


#### Simple t-Test
```{r}
eset_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "eset_human_mouse.rds"))
human_mouse_fluad_matrix = eset_human_mouse %>% exprs()
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_metadata.rds"))


human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human = human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
           filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
             filter(!participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                             "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                             "CRC305DGENT1471032")) %>% 
             pull(sample_id))) %>% 
  as.matrix()

human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData = human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>% 
                                   filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
                                   filter(!participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                             "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                             "CRC305DGENT1471032")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.factor(timepoint),
         sex = as.factor(sex),
         age = scale(as.numeric(age)),
         race = as.factor(race))

#Annotate
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, human_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long.rds"))


#Pivot wider
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide = human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  select(-c(value:day0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id",
              values_from = "log2fc")

beep()


#Import
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long.rds"))


#Compute summary statistics
human_fluad_log2fc_summary = human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_")

# Paired t-test
human_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest <- human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

# Unpaired t-test ----------
human_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      timepoint == "day1" ~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
      timepoint == "day3" ~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
      timepoint == "day7" ~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
      TRUE ~ timepoint),
    timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
    test = "t-Test",
    paired = "Unpaired")




human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = human_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(human_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

#### Quality control
Import
```{r}
#Import
eset_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "eset_human_mouse.rds"))
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# Create a long format table
long_expr <- as.data.frame(human_mouse_fluad_matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "expression") %>%
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata, by = "sample_id")

# Calculate the median for each gene by organism
long_expr <- long_expr %>%
  group_by(gene, organism) %>%
  mutate(gene_median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
         RLE = expression - gene_median) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot RLE
rle_plot <- ggplot(long_expr, aes(x = participant_id, y = RLE, fill = organism, color = organism)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, color = "red", fill = "red",
               data = long_expr %>% 
                 filter(participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                           "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                           "CRC305DGENT1471032"))) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Day", timepoint),  ncol = 1) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "RLE Plot by Organism", y = "Relative Log Expression", x = "Sample") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(FIT = "#4361ee",
                               Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               Human = "#90A4AEFF"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(FIT = "#4361ee",
                                Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                Human = "#90A4AEFF")) 

# Print
print(rle_plot)
```

#### Check distributions

##### From expression and log2fc
```{r}
#Raw expression + normalized
human_mouse_fluad_not_normalized = GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol %>% 
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-symbol,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>% 
  bind_rows(GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_symbol %>% 
              pivot_longer(-symbol,
                names_to = "sample_id",
                values_to = "value_raw"))

#Annotate ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn = human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-symbol,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "value_qn") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_not_normalized, 
               by = join_by("symbol", "sample_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata,
             by = "sample_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(value_qn, value_raw),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn.rds"))

#Calculate the avg expression
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarize(avg = mean(value),
            n_subjects = n(),
            sd = sd(value),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects)) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg.rds"))


# Log2FoldChange ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(measure %in% c("value_qn", "value_raw"),
         # timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7)
         ) %>%
  select(participant_id, symbol, timepoint, value, measure, organism) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, symbol, measure) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc.rds"))

#Average L2FC
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarize(avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T),
            n_subjects = n(),
            #Dispersion
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size = avg_log2fc/sd,
            #Get pval from paired t-test
    pval = tryCatch(t.test(value, day0, paired = TRUE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se,
         ci_high = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se,
         pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"))
  
#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg.rds"))

beep()
```

```{r}
# Calculate quantiles for each sample and measure
quantile_summary <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(sample_id, measure) %>%
  summarize(
    q0   = quantile(value, probs = 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(value, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(value, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(value, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(value, probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("q"), names_to = "quantile", values_to = "value")

# Plot the quantiles
ggplot(quantile_summary, aes(x = quantile %>% fct_relevel("q0", "q25", "q50", "q75","q100"), 
                             y = value, 
                             group = measure, 
                             color = measure)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.2)) +
  labs(title = "Per-sample quantile distribution: raw vs. quantile-normalized",
       x = "Quantiles") +
  theme_vaxgo()

human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(measure, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    q0   = quantile(value, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(value, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(value, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

###### Summarize interindividual and interspecies correlation  (log2fc for every sample)
####### All genes
```{r}
#Calculate correlation ------

#Get DEGs from both organisms
human_or_mouse_degs = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  filter(measure == "value_raw",
         timepoint %in% c(1, 3, 7)) %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, pval_adj) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "pval_adj") %>% #14150 genes
  filter(Human <= 0.05 & Mouse <= 0.05) %>%  #322 genes
  select(symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

#Compute correlation
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>%
  filter(measure == "value_raw") %>%
  select(timepoint, symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
  inner_join(human_or_mouse_degs,
             by = join_by("timepoint", "symbol")) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  
  # Pivot wider and calculate correlation
  group_modify(~ {
    .x %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-symbol) %>%
      cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman") %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-participant1, names_to = "participant2", values_to = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant1 != participant2)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  #Filter by organism
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(participant_id, participant_1_organism = organism, sex_p_1 = sex) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by("participant1" == "participant_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(participant_id, participant_2_organism = organism, sex_p_2 = sex) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by("participant2" == "participant_id")) 


# Remove duplicated lines only if the organism is the same
correlation_long_all_timepoints_same_organisms = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints %>%
  filter(participant_1_organism == participant_2_organism) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_min = pmin(participant1, participant2),
    participant_max = pmax(participant1, participant2)
  ) %>%
  # Remove duplicates (ex: A vs B e B vs A)
  distinct(timepoint, participant_min, participant_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(timepoint, participant1, participant2, correlation, participant_1_organism, participant_2_organism, sex_p_1, sex_p_2) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  arrange(-correlation)


#Unite table with different organisms with table with deduplicated rows with the same organism
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints %>% 
  filter(participant_1_organism != participant_2_organism) %>% 
  bind_rows(correlation_long_all_timepoints_same_organisms)

#Summarize data and save table
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints %>% 
  
  #Filter only female and set Mouse as reference
  filter(sex_p_1 == "Female", 
         sex_p_2 == "Female") %>% 
  mutate(sex_comparison = paste(sex_p_1, "vs.", sex_p_2),
         comparison = paste(participant_1_organism, "vs.", participant_2_organism)) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, comparison) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, -correlation) %>% 
  mutate(correlation = round(correlation, 2),
         timepoint = paste("Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(2),
            median = median(correlation, na.rm = T)%>% round(2),
            min = min(correlation, na.rm = T)%>% round(2),
            max = max(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(2),
            sd = sd(correlation),
            n = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
            se = sd/sqrt(n),
            t_critical = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
            ci_lower = mean - t_critical * se,
            ci_upper = mean + t_critical * se,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(comparison != "Human vs. Mouse")

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

#Save
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "Fluad_correlation_genes_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary.rds"))

```

```{r}
#Boxplot by organism, averaged --------
distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_log2fc_boxplot = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(1)) %>% 
  drop_na(avg_log2fc) %>% 
  mutate(measure = case_when(measure == "value_raw" ~ "Not normalized",
                             measure == "value_qn" ~ "Quantile\nnormalized",
                             T ~ measure)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = avg_log2fc,
      x = organism,
      label = organism) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = organism)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white", 
               outliers = F, width = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(~measure~fct_rev(organism), scales = "free_x", space = "free", axes = "all_x", axis.labels = "all_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), 
                     # limits = c(-1, 1)
                     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        ) +
  labs(fill = "Organism",
       x = "Organism",
       y = "Log2-Fold Change")
```

##### Plot volcano plot
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=16}
#Volcano plot -------
volcano_data <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  mutate(logp = -log10(pval_adj),
         sig = case_when(avg_log2fc > 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Up",
                         avg_log2fc < 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Down",
                         TRUE ~ "NS"),
         measure = case_when(measure == "value_qn" ~ "QN",
                             measure == "value_raw" ~ "Raw",
                             T~measure))
volcano_plot_raw_qn = volcano_data %>% 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_log2fc, y = logp, fill = sig) +
  facet_nested(~paste("Day", timepoint)+organism + measure, scales = "free_y",  space = "free_y", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "black")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig,
                 color = sig),
             pch = 21, 
             size = 1, 
             alpha = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = 1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, color = "black", linetype = 2, size = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60),
                     limits = c(0, 70),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  guides(color = F) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  labs(x = "Log2-Fold Change",
       y = "-log(FDR)",
       fill = "Direction") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0)) 

volcano_plot_raw_qn
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
# PCA -------

# PCA with raw values
clean_matrix_raw = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(symbol %in% human_degs) %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(measure == "value_raw") %>% 
  select(sample, symbol, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "value") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_raw[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw)] <- 0

pca_raw <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw$x)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

# PCA with quantile normalized ----
clean_matrix_qn = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% human_degs) %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(measure == "value_qn") %>% 
  select(sample, symbol, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "value") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_qn[!is.finite(clean_matrix_qn)] <- 0

pca_qn <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_qn), scale. = TRUE)
pca_qn_df <- as_tibble(pca_qn$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_qn$x)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
#Mouse with DEGs in human-------
annotation_samples_mouse_pca = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(participant_id, organism, timepoint, sample) %>% 
  distinct()

#Get DEGs from human
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("tables", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))
human_degs_vector = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_adj_human <= 0.05) %>% 
  select(symbol) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pull(symbol)

#Use only DEGs in human
clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         symbol %in% c(human_degs_vector),
         measure == "value_raw") %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(sample, symbol, log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

#Fill NAs with 0
clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs)] <- 0

#Normalize data
pca_raw_mouse_human_degs <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_mouse_human_degs_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw_mouse_human_degs$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw_mouse_human_degs$x)) %>%
  inner_join(annotation_samples_mouse_pca, by = "sample")
```

# Found in translation
Ref: Normand, R., Du, W., Briller, M. et al. Found In Translation: a machine learning model for mouse-to-human inference. Nat Methods 15, 1067–1073 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-018-0214-9
Github: https://github.com/shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man 
```{r}
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
#Import files

best_models = FIT.mouse2man::best_models
```

### Loop for every time point
Obs.: Make sure that datasets from FIT package were retrieved
Initial number of genes: 15503
Number of genes for which FIT predictions will be calculated: 14401
```{r}
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "Fluad_GSE120661_degs_mouse.rds"))
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
### Loop for every time point -----
all_degs_fit2 = all_degs_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, EffectSize = logFC, condition) %>%
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
               select(symbol = human_symbol, MM.Entrez = mouse_entrez),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(row = MM.Entrez)

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row") %>% 
    select(MM.Entrez, EffectSize)
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")

  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})
beep()
#Print
fit_results_combined

#Save
fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "FIT_FLUAD_alltimes.rds"))


#Visualize distribution
fit_results_combined %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = FIT_prediction,
      fill = condition,
      color = condition) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_vaxgo()
```

### Integrate Mouse, FIT, and Human data
```{r}
#Import datasets
fit_example_results_ready = readRDS(file = here("tables", "fit_example_results_ready.rds"))
fluad_human_degs = read_rds(file = here("tables", "fluad_human_limma_fit_degs.rds"))
all_degs_mouse = read_rds(file = here("tables", "Fluad_GSE120661_degs_mouse.rds"))
GSE120661_metadata = read_csv(here("tables", "GSE120661_metadata.csv")) 
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_metadata.rds"))

#Clean tables
human_mouse_fluad_metadata_datasets = human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  select(vaccine, sample_type, timepoint, condition, organism, type, array) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))


# Annotate genes by entrez_id ------
#Get gene annotation
genes_ann = fit_example_results_ready %>% 
  select(mouse_entrez, human_entrez,human_symbol) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(human_entrez = as.character(human_entrez))

#Human
fluad_human = fluad_human_degs %>% 
  select(condition,
         human_symbol = symbol, 
         log2fc = mean,
         ci_low = lower,
         ci_high = upper,
         p_value,
         adj_p_val,
         organism,
         t
         ) %>% 
  mutate(ci_size = ci_high - ci_low,
         organism = "Human") %>% 
  inner_join(genes_ann, by = join_by("human_symbol")) %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol)

#Mouse
fluad_mouse = all_degs_mouse %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol, 
         log2fc = logFC,
         ci_low = CI.L,
         ci_high = CI.R,
         p_value = P.Value,
         adj_p_val = adj.P.Val,
         t,
         ) %>% 
  mutate(ci_size = ci_high - ci_low,
         organism = "Mouse")

#FIT
fluad_fit = fit_example_results_ready %>% 
  filter(measure == "fit_prediction") %>% 
  select(condition, 
         mouse_entrez, 
         human_entrez,
         mouse_symbol,
         symbol = human_symbol, 
         log2fc = value,
         ci_low,
         ci_high,
         ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "FIT",
         ci_size = ci_high - ci_low) %>% 
  #Get only the human entrez id used
  filter(human_entrez %in% c(fluad_human$human_entrez)) %>% 
  select(!c(mouse_entrez, human_entrez, mouse_symbol)) %>% 
  #Calculate pvalues
   mutate(
  se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
  z = log2fc / se,
  p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)),
  adj_p_val = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% 
  select(-se)

#Combine tables
fit_fluad_mouse_human = fluad_human %>% 
  bind_rows(fluad_mouse, 
            fluad_fit) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_datasets %>% 
               select(condition, vaccine, timepoint, type),
             by = "condition") %>% 
  arrange(symbol) %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(1, 3, 7)) %>% 
  select(!c(human_entrez, mouse_entrez))

#Save
fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "fit_fluad_mouse_human.rds"))

#Save long dataset
fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  mutate(condition =  paste(organism, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds"))

#Print
fit_fluad_mouse_human

```


6373 human genes were analyzed

Filtered:
- 5563 genes with padj > 0.10
- 3673 genes with padj > 0.50
- 1001 genes with padj > 0.90

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
#Make the table wider manually -----

#FIT
meta_fit = fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>% 
  select(symbol, 
         timepoint, 
         z_fit = z,
         mean_fit = log2fc, 
         ci_low_fit = ci_low,
         ci_high_fit = ci_high,
         ci_width_fit = ci_size,
         pval_adj_fit = adj_p_val,
         pval_fit = p_value
         )

#Mouse
meta_mouse = fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  select(symbol, 
         timepoint, 
         t_mouse = t,
         mean_mouse = log2fc, 
         ci_low_mouse = ci_low,
         ci_high_mouse = ci_high,
         ci_width_mouse = ci_size,
         pval_adj_mouse = adj_p_val,
         pval_mouse = p_value
         ) %>% 
  #Filter out repeated values
  arrange(symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(mean_mouse_round =  mean_mouse %>% round(3),
           value = (ci_high_mouse + ci_low_mouse) / 2,
         value = value %>% round(3)) %>% 
  mutate(test = if_else(value == mean_mouse_round, "T", "no")) %>% 
  filter(test == "T") %>% 
  select(-c(test, value, mean_mouse_round))

#Human
meta_human = fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(symbol, 
         timepoint, 
         t_human = t,
         mean_human = log2fc, 
         ci_low_human = ci_low,
         ci_high_human = ci_high,
         ci_width_human = ci_size,
         pval_adj_human = adj_p_val,
         pval_human = p_value)

#Unite and calculate summary statistics
pairwise_human_fit_measures = meta_human %>% 
  inner_join(meta_fit, by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(meta_mouse, by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(human_2_mouse = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         human_2_fit = mean_human - mean_fit) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
    mutate(
    # Estimate SE from CIs
    se_human = (ci_high_human - ci_low_human) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_fit = (ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_mouse = (ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse) / (2 * 1.96),
    
    # Combine SE
    se_diff_h2fit = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_fit^2),
    se_diff_h2m = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_mouse^2),
    
    # Z score
    z_score_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_h2fit,
    z_score_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_h2m,
    
    # p-value
    p_value_h2fit = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_h2fit))),
    p_value_h2m = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_h2m))),
    
    # FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg)
    p_value_h2fit_adj = p.adjust(p_value_h2fit, method = "BH"),
    p_value_h2m_adj = p.adjust(p_value_h2m, method = "BH"),
    
    # Cohen's d
    effect_size_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_h2fit,
    effect_size_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_h2m)  %>% 
  
  
  #Reorder cols
  select(
    timepoint, symbol,
    #Human
    mean_human, t_human,
    ci_low_human, ci_high_human, ci_width_human,
    se_human, pval_human, pval_adj_human,
    #FIT
    mean_fit, z_fit,
    ci_low_fit, ci_high_fit, ci_width_fit,
    se_fit, pval_fit, pval_adj_fit,
    #Mouse
    mean_mouse, t_mouse,
    ci_low_mouse, ci_high_mouse, ci_width_mouse,
    se_mouse, pval_mouse, pval_adj_mouse,
    #Comparison
    human_2_mouse,
    human_2_fit,
    se_diff_h2fit, se_diff_h2m,
    z_score_h2fit, z_score_h2m,
    p_value_h2fit, p_value_h2fit_adj,
    p_value_h2m, p_value_h2m_adj,
    effect_size_h2fit, effect_size_h2m
  )

#Save wide dataset
pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))

#Print
pairwise_human_fit_measures
```

## BTMs means expression

Annotate genes-BTMs
```{r}
#Import
#Import Genes-BTMs table
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))

#Import BTMs-Groups-Subgroups
btm_annotation = read.table(file = here("VaxGO",  "BTM functional groups V3.txt"), sep="\t", header=TRUE) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(id = name) %>% 
  filter(group != "")

#Merge Genes-BTMs with groups annotations
btm_annotation_genes = ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes %>% 
               inner_join(btm_annotation %>% 
                            rename(process = id), 
                          by = "process") %>% 
               rename(symbol = genes)

#Save
btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  write_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
```


Merge genes-BTMs to gene expression
```{r}
#Import expression table
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc = 
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc.rds"))

dge_long_genes = 
  read_rds(file= here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds"))

#Clean annotation table
```

#### Plot means of means

```{r}
#Annotate genes by BTM
btm_annotation_genes = btm_annotation %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>% 
  inner_join(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes,
             by = "process") %>% 
  rename(symbol = genes)

#Calculate means for each gene and organism
human_mouse_fluad_raw_log2fc_means = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  filter(measure == "value_raw",
         timepoint %in% c(1, 3, 7)
         ) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, symbol) %>% 
  summarize(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T)) 

#Merge with genes log2fc
human_mouse_fluad_raw_log2fc_means_btm = human_mouse_fluad_raw_log2fc_means %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, symbol, group, subgroup),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup()

#Calculate mean
#By BTM group
dge_btm_mean_process = human_mouse_fluad_raw_log2fc_means_btm %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 1 ) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarize(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_log2fc),
            group, subgroup) %>% 
  group_by(process, subgroup, group) %>%
  select(-timepoint) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  ungroup()

dge_btm_mean_process

#Unite with FIT
dge_btm_mean_process_FIT = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT",
         timepoint == 1) %>% 
  select(symbol, log2fc, organism) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "log2fc",values_fn = median) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, symbol, group, subgroup),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  group_by(process) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  summarize(process, FIT = mean(FIT),
            group, subgroup) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process, by = join_by("process", "group", "subgroup"))

```



Plot correlation
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Mouse vs Human
#Calculate correlation
cor_labels <- dge_btm_mean_process_FIT %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(process, Human, Mouse) %>% 
  summarise(cor_value = cor(x = Human, 
                            y = Mouse, 
                            use = "pairwise.complete.obs", 
                            method = "pearson"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(r_squared = cor_value ^ 2,
         cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2)))

#Plot correlation plot
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot = dge_btm_mean_process_FIT %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = Mouse,
      y = Human,
      labels = process) +
  #Plot all points
  geom_point(aes(fill = group),
             color = "black",
             size = 2,
             alpha = 0.8,
             pch = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  guides(color = F) +
  labs(fill = "Immune group",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)") +
  ylim(-1.5, 2) +
  xlim(-1.5, 1.5) +
  #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  
  #Add correlation metrics
  geom_label(data = cor_labels,
            aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label), 
            fill= "white",
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  
  # geom_text_repel(aes(label = process), size = 2, max.overlaps = 200000) +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.direction = "vertical",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
          )
```

```{r}
#Matrix data
matrix_data = dge_btm_mean_process  %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 1) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "Model") %>% 
  select(process,Human, FIT, Mouse) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process") %>% 
  as.matrix()

# Column and row annotation
######## Annotations
annotation_heatmap = tribble(~condition, ~timepoint, ~organism,
        "Human", 1, "Human",
        "Mouse", 1, "Mouse")

#Arrange columns in the same order as the matrix
ann_cols_heatmap = matrix_data %>% 
  colnames() %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  rename(condition = '.') %>% 
  inner_join(annotation_heatmap, by = "condition") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(condition)

#Arrange matrix columns 
mat = matrix_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(ann_cols_heatmap$condition %>% unique())) %>% 
  as.matrix() 

#Column to rownames
ann_cols_heatmap = ann_cols_heatmap %>% 
  column_to_rownames("condition")

#Annotate rows
ann_rows_heatmap = mat %>% 
  rownames() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename("process" = ".") %>% 
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup), 
             by = "process") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")
```

####Plot correlation
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#Order factors
participant_order = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  select(participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pull()

#Sample human 5 participants
set.seed(3141)
sample_participants_5 = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  pull()


#Plot data
plot_data <-
  #1st participant
  dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  #Filter participants (5 mouse, 5 human)
  filter(participant_id %in% c(sample_participants_5,participant_order)) %>% 
  # filter(organism == "Mouse",
  #        timepoint == "1") %>% 
  rename(participant_1 = participant_id, 
         participant_1_value = mean_log2fc) %>% 
  
  #Add a column to the 2nd participant
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
               filter(participant_id %in% c(sample_participants_5,participant_order)) %>% 
               # filter(organism == "Mouse",
               #        timepoint == "1") %>% 
               rename(participant_2 = participant_id, 
                      participant_2_value = mean_log2fc),
    by = c("process", "group", "subgroup", "organism", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Remove identical pairs
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
  
  #Remove dupes (ex: A-B e B-A → A-B)
  mutate(pair_min = pmin(participant_1, participant_2),
         pair_max = pmax(participant_1, participant_2)) %>%
  distinct(process, pair_min, pair_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  
  # Arrange participants to create a pairwise matrix
  mutate(
    participant_1 = factor(participant_1, levels = participant_order),
    participant_2 = factor(participant_2, levels = rev(participant_order))) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Compute correlation
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(organism, timepoint, pair_min, pair_max) %>%
  summarise(cor_value = cor(participant_1_value, participant_2_value, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2))
  )

cor_labels
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=20}
#Mouse ------
timepoints <- c("1", "3", "7")
organisms <- c("Mouse")

plots_mouse <- map2(timepoints, organisms, ~ {
  
  timepoint_selected <- .x
  organism_selected <- .y
  
  plot_data %>% 
    mutate(pair_max = fct_relevel(pair_max, participant_order)) %>% 
    filter(organism == organism_selected,
           timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = participant_1_value, y = participant_2_value, color = group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
    facet_grid(pair_min ~ pair_max, axes = "all",
               scales = "free",
               drop = TRUE) +
    stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 0.5, se = FALSE, size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
    geom_label(data = cor_labels %>%
                 filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected,
                        organism == organism_selected),
               aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),

})
```

###### Summarize interindividual correlation

```{r}
#Calculate correlation ------
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  select(timepoint, process, participant_id, mean_log2fc) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  
  # Pivot wider and calculate correlation
  group_modify(~ {
    .x %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc) %>%
      select(-process) %>%
      cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-participant1, names_to = "participant2", values_to = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant1 != participant2)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  #Filter by organism
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(participant_id, participant_1_organism = organism, sex_p_1 = sex) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by("participant1" == "participant_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(participant_id, participant_2_organism = organism, sex_p_2 = sex) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by("participant2" == "participant_id")) 


# Remove duplicated lines only if the organism is the same
correlation_long_all_timepoints_same_organisms = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints %>%
  filter(participant_1_organism == participant_2_organism) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_min = pmin(participant1, participant2),
    participant_max = pmax(participant1, participant2)
  ) %>%
  # Remove duplicates (ex: A vs B e B vs A)
  distinct(timepoint, participant_min, participant_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(timepoint, participant1, participant2, correlation, participant_1_organism, participant_2_organism, sex_p_1, sex_p_2) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  arrange(-correlation)


#Unite table with different organisms with table with deduplicated rows with the same organism
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints %>% 
  filter(participant_1_organism != participant_2_organism) %>% 
  bind_rows(correlation_long_all_timepoints_same_organisms)

#Summarize data and save table
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints %>% 
  
  #Filter only female and set Mouse as reference
  filter(sex_p_1 == "Female", 
         sex_p_2 == "Female") %>% 
  mutate(sex_comparison = paste(sex_p_1, "vs.", sex_p_2),
         comparison = paste(participant_1_organism, "vs.", participant_2_organism)) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, comparison) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, -correlation) %>% 
  mutate(correlation = round(correlation, 2),
         timepoint = paste("Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(2),
            median = median(correlation, na.rm = T)%>% round(2),
            min = min(correlation, na.rm = T)%>% round(2),
            max = max(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(2),
            sd = sd(correlation),
            n = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
            se = sd/sqrt(n),
            t_critical = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
            ci_lower = mean - t_critical * se,
            ci_upper = mean + t_critical * se,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(comparison != "Human vs. Mouse")

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

#Save
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "Fluad_correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary.rds"))

```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
  separate(timepoint, into = c("unit", "timepoint"), remove = T) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = as.numeric(timepoint),
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
      color = comparison,
      fill = comparison) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  
  geom_textline(aes(label = comparison), 
                size = 3, 
                vjust = -0.5,
                hjust = 0.8,
                linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower,

  geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 7), expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
```

### Get by zscore

Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile

#### Mouse
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile -----
#By zscores ------
#Mouse
zscore_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_test %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_mouse, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2m) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2m, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs Mouse") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2m,
         mean_model = mean_mouse,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_mouse) %>% 
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(
    quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Pivot and sum only DEGs
zscore_genes_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, model, deg) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

####FIT
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#FIT
zscore_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_test %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_fit, pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2fit) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2fit, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_fit,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_fit = round(mean_fit, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs FIT") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2fit,
         mean_model = mean_fit,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_fit) %>%
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"))
```

Summarize genes by quantile
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Summarize genes by quantile ------
degs_pos_neg_summary_quantiles_best_worst_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
         pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  mutate(
    quartiles_grouped = case_when(
      quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
      quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  drop_na(quartiles_grouped) %>% 
  group_by(comparison, timepoint, quartiles_grouped) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparison == "Human vs FIT" ~ paste("FIT", quartiles_grouped),
                               comparison == "Human vs Mouse" ~ paste("Mouse", quartiles_grouped),
                               T~comparison)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

### Scatterplot of correlation
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
#Scatterplot of correlation --------
#Get all genes by quantile
quantiles <- zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    q10  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Cumulative quantiles
diff_correlation_plot_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(quantiles, by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(
    Q10  = abs(zscore) <= q10,
    Q25  = abs(zscore) <= q25,
    Q50  = abs(zscore) <= q50,
    Q75  = abs(zscore) <= q75,
    Q100 = abs(zscore) <= q100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Q10, Q25, Q50, Q75, Q100),
    names_to = "quantile_label_grouped",
    values_to = "in_quantile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quantile_label_grouped = fct_relevel(quantile_label_grouped, "Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_quantile) %>%
  select(-in_quantile)

#Print
diff_correlation_plot_data

#Diagnostics

  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj, comparison) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(comparison, model, timepoint, deg) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

```{r}
# Lineplot of selected genes -----
#Selected genes by quantile and model
selected_genes_lines_fit = diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  filter(quartile_label == c("Q10") & comparison == "Human vs FIT", 
         pval_model_adj == "DEG" | pval_human_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, comparison, quartile_label, zscore) %>% 
  mutate(quartile_label = "<=Q10") %>% 
    distinct()

  filter(quartile_label == c("Q10") & comparison == "Human vs Mouse", 
         pval_model_adj == "DEG" | pval_human_adj == "DEG") %>%

#Get l2fc 
selected_genes_lines = diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human, mean_model, comparison) %>% 
  inner_join(selected_genes_lines_models %>% 
               select(human_symbol, comparison),
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "comparison")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  bind_rows(selected_genes_lines_models %>% 
              select(human_symbol,comparison) %>% 
              mutate(timepoint = 0,
                     mean_human = 0,

  arrange(human_symbol)  %>%

  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human, mean_model,comparison) %>%

  bind_rows(selected_genes_lines_all %>% 
              mutate(timepoint = 0,
                     mean_human = 0,
                     mean_model = 0)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol)


#Filter top 5 genes
top5_genes = selected_genes_lines_models %>% 
  # filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>% 
  group_by(comparison) %>% 
  slice_min(abs(zscore), n = 5) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, comparison, zscore) %>% 
  inner_join(selected_genes_lines, by = join_by("human_symbol", "comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(group = case_when(str_detect(comparison, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                       str_detect(comparison, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))
#Get labels for the top 5 genes
top5_genes_labels = top5_genes %>% 
  filter(timepoint > 0) %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, comparison) %>% 
  slice_max(mean_human, n = 1)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

#Discretize by quartile
df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse = zscore_genes %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<Q25",
    quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">Q75",
    TRUE ~ quartile_label)) %>% 
    mutate(condition = paste0(comparison, "", quartiles_grouped, " (", timepoint_day,")")) %>% 
  filter(quartiles_grouped != "Q50") %>% 
  select(genes = human_symbol,
         condition)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "(?<=\\(Day )\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = case_when(str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))

#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark
```


##### Plot ORA Hallmark
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
##### Plot ORA Hallmark ------
#Import
ora_all_diff_hallmark = readRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))
#Cluster rows
row_clustered = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_p_adjust) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_p_adjust") %>%
    column_to_rownames("description") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
    dist(.) %>% 
    hclust()

#Plot
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "Q\\d{2,3}"),
        condition = paste(quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", 
            size = 0.2, na.rm = F, stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#4DBBD5FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.2, 'cm'),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust=0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 1, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, MSigDB Hallmarks") +
  facet_nested(~ paste("Day", timepoint) + fct_rev(comparison), scales = "free", space = "free") 

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap

#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "ORA_Best_Worst_heatmap.png"),
         width = 8,
         height = 8)
```
