# Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse

```{r}
#Import data
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("tables", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds")) 
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
# Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse -----
pairwise_human_fit_genes_long =  pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_human, mean_mouse, mean_fit),
               values_to = "l2fc",
               names_to = "organism") %>% 
  rename(diff_h2m = human_2_mouse,
         diff_h2fit = human_2_fit) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(organism == "FIT Prediction", "FIT", organism)) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(symbol, timepoint, organism),
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "metric") %>% 
  mutate(
    organism = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "human") ~ "Human",
      str_detect(metric, "fit") ~ "FIT",
      str_detect(metric, "mouse") ~ "Mouse",
      metric == "Human" ~ "Human",
      metric == "FIT Prediction" ~ "FIT",
      TRUE ~ organism),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)$"),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(metric, "h2m") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(metric, "h2") ~ "FIT",
                              T~organism))  %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(organism == "mean_fit" ~ "FIT",
                              organism == "mean_human" ~ "Human",
                              organism == "mean_mouse" ~ "Mouse",
                              T ~ organism))

#Comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>%
    select(timepoint, symbol, human_2_mouse:effect_size_h2m) 

#Pivot table and join the comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide = pairwise_human_fit_genes_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "metric",
              values_from = "value", 
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  select(!c(pval:effect_size_h2m)) %>% 
  inner_join(pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons,
                by = join_by("timepoint", "symbol")) 


#Get top genes in each model
top_genes_human = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  relocate(ci_width,  .after = organism) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(ci_width) 
  
 top_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2m_adj), human_2_mouse)
 
 top_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2fit_adj), human_2_fit)
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
      color = organism,
      fill = organism) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray75", alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = organism), position = position_dodge2(1)) +
  # facet_wrap(~day~human_symbol, nrow = 3, scales = "free") +
  facet_grid(~day~symbol, scales = "free") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, 
                  ymax = ci_high),
                position =  position_dodge(1)
                ) +
      geom_point( position = position_dodge(1),
             color = "black",
             pch = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 3, 7),minor_breaks = F) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    "Mouse" = "#546E7AFF",
    "Human" = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    "Mouse" = "#546E7AFF",
    "Human" = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
    theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", angle = 0),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Organism",
       x = "",
       y = "LogFold-Change",
       title = "Top genes in Mouse prediction. Difference in Z-score to human")
```

#### Get ranks
```{r}
#Get ranks -----
#Mouse
ranks_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2m, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2m)
#FIT
ranks_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2fit, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2fit)

#Fit vs Mouse
ranks_fit_vs_mouse = ranks_fit %>% 
  select(symbol, fit = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_mouse %>% 
               select(symbol, mouse = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top FIT vs Mouse")

#Mouse vs FIT
ranks_mouse_vs_fit = ranks_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, mouse = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_fit %>% 
               select(symbol, fit = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top Mouse vs FIT")


#Get genes that are in the 10th percentile in one model, but are in the 90th percentile in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%
  filter(fit < 10, mouse > 90) %>%
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(mouse < 10, fit > 90)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit, zscore_h2fit,
         mouse, zscore_h2mouse)

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "percentile"
  )


#Get genes with least zscores in one model, but have the highest zscore in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%

  # FILTER BY N
  filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2fit), desc(abs(zscore_h2mouse))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2mouse), desc(abs(zscore_h2fit))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit = zscore_h2fit,
         mouse = zscore_h2mouse)
#Pivot longer
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "zscore"
  )

#Print
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
#Plot percentiles -------
#Select genes
selected_genes = ranks_best_fit_and_mouse %>% 
  group_by(condition, timepoint_ref, timepoint_other) %>% 
  filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>% 
  # filter(fit < 1 | mouse <1) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "percentile"
  ) 

#Plot
ranks_percentile_best_fit_and_mouse_long_plot = ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long %>% 
  filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = model, y = percentile, group = interaction(condition, symbol), color = condition) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2))) +
  geom_text_repel(data = selected_genes %>%
                    inner_join(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes %>% 
                                               select(symbol = genes) %>% 
                                               distinct() %>% 
                                               mutate(gene_function = "Immune"),
                  by = "symbol") %>% 
                    mutate(gene_function = "Other") %>% 
                    filter(condition == "Top FIT vs Mouse" & model == "mouse") %>% 
                    arrange(-percentile) %>% 
                    slice_max(percentile, n = 3),
             mapping = aes(label = symbol,
                           x = model,
                           y = percentile),
             color = "black",
             segment.color = "#4361ee",
             direction = c("y"),
             size = 2.5, 
            min.segment.length = 0.5,
             max.overlaps = 10000, 
             force = 2,
             nudge_x = 1, 
            hjust = "left") +
  
geom_text_repel(data = selected_genes %>%
                    filter(condition == "Top Mouse vs FIT" & model == "fit") %>% 
                  arrange(-percentile) %>% 
                  slice_max(percentile, n = 3),
                color = "black",
             segment.color = "#4DBBD5FF",
             direction = c("y"),
             mapping = aes(label = symbol,
                           x = model,
                           y = percentile),
             size = 2.5, 
             min.segment.length = 0.5,
             max.overlaps = 10000, 
             nudge_x = -1, 
             force = 2, hjust = "right") +
  facet_grid(~paste("Day", timepoint_ref))  +
  labs(x = "Model",
       y = "Percentile",
       color = ""
       # title = "Best 10% versus worst 100%"
       ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Top FIT vs Mouse" = "#4361ee", 
    "Top Mouse vs FIT" = "#4DBBD5FF")) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), limits = c(0, 110)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", angle = 0), 
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA))
  
#Print
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=8}
  ungroup() %>%
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=3}
    mutate(model = case_when(str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse", 
                          str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                          T ~ NA),
           symbol = fct_relevel(symbol, c(row_clustered$labels)), 
           condition = if_else(str_detect(condition, "Best"), "Best", "Worst"))%>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=model, y = symbol, fill = l2fc, color= l2fc)) +
  geom_tile(size = 0.2, na.rm = F, stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "#45efc6",
  mid = "white",  
  high = "#165289",
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(-1, 1),
        name = "L2FC") +
  scale_color_gradient2(
  low = "#45efc6",
  mid = "white",  
  high = "#165289",
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(-1, 1),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "L2FC") +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          # axis.line.x  = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, size = 0),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, 
                                      margin = margin(0.2,1,0.2,1, "cm")),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "bottom") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "Best and Worst genes, Overlap") +
  facet_nested(~ paste("Day", timepoint) + condition, scales = "free", space = "free")
```

# Performance tests 

## ROC Curve 

Do for one direction (up and then down) Do one sided t test for mouse,
fit, and human Positive control: Human Neg control: Random permutation

Import data

```{r}
#Import DEGs table
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file= here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds")) 
#Import metadata
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_metadata.rds"))
#ImmuneGO ontologies
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))


dge_long_genes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(organism != "FIT") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>%
               group_by(organism, timepoint) %>%
               summarize(n = n()) %>% 
               mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)),
               by = join_by("organism", "timepoint"))
#All genes
genes_roc_allgenes = dge_long_genes
#Filter immune genes
genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))

#Only DEGs
degs_genes_human = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint)

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_all = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint"))

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_immune = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Filter immune genes only
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))
```

Calculate ROC curve

Inputs
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
set.seed(123)
######### Input -----

#All genes

# filename = "Fluad_All_OnlyImmune"
# genes_df_input = bind_rows(
#   genes_roc_allgenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
#   genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
# )

#Human DEGs

filename = "Fluad_AllDEGs_HumanDEGs_OnlyImmune"
genes_df_input = bind_rows(
  genes_roc_DEGs_all %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
  genes_roc_DEGs_immune %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
)

```



### Using t statistic to compute probabilities
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}

#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

uniform_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Uniform",
         model = "Uniform")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

uniform_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Uniform",
         model = "Uniform")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, uniform_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, uniform_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~paste("Day", timepoint)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Uniform" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)


# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, y = factor(timepoint) %>% fct_rev(), fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8,
           position = position_dodge()) +
  
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = round(auc, 2)),
            position = position_dodge2(0.9),
            hjust = 1.2, size = 2) +
  
  facet_grid(comparison ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    x = "AUC",
    y = "Day",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Uniform" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  auc_plot) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 0.4))+
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)),
                  title = filename)

roc_auc_curve_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0("roc_curve_plot_", filename, ".png")),
         width = 8,
         height = 5)

roc_auc_curve_plot
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(mean_human_next), !is.na(mean_mouse_next)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!(mean_human == mean_human_next & mean_mouse == mean_mouse_next))
```
